title: Pilot Ops-Lite Playbook: SE Slide Kit (Draft)
content:
Slide 1: Purpose and TL;DR
- One-slide summary sellers can email: Pilot = 6-week 'Ops-Lite' with reserved throughput, scoped prompts, and built-in fallback.
- Goal: prove value, measure latency & cost per user, unblock Dedicated conversation.
- Offer: 2-week quickstart + 4-week pilot with simple rollback triggers.

----
Slide 2: Why 'Ops-Lite' (customer problem we solve)
- Customers want production-like signals but won't commit to Dedicated.
- Common asks: latency predictability, cost cap, safe fallback when quality regresses.
- Ops-Lite = minimal SRE + bounded resource commitment + seller-managed rollout.

----
Slide 3: Value props to lead with (3 bullets)
- Predictable per-token economics during pilot (cost cap + weekly cadence).
- Rapid reliability guarantees: automatic fallback to cheaper model on high error/latency.
- Low-integration friction: same API as hosted, no infra changes for pilot.

----
Slide 4: Pilot offer components (what we deliver)
- Reserved burst pool for pilot (X vGPU-equivalents, configurable).
- Routing policy template: primary model -> fallback variant -> region fallback.
- Standard SLOs for pilot: p95 latency target, error budget, quality validation tests.
- Weekly data share: token usage, latency histogram, top 10 error traces.

----
Slide 5: Success criteria (seller playbook checklist)
- Business: conversion metric (e.g., N trial users -> N paid seats or API keys issued).
- Technical: p95 latency < target, cost per 1k tokens within agreed range, no major quality regressions on eval set.
- Ops: automated fallback engaged < 5% of requests, successful canary rollouts.

----
Slide 6: Quick integration checklist for SEs (copyable)
- 1) Create sandbox API key + share token with SE hub.
- 2) Import evaluation prompt set (we provide template).
- 3) Configure routing policy using our console snippet (insert snippet).
- 4) Enable prefix caching for common prefixes.
- 5) Turn on pilot cost cap and weekly alerting.
- Notes to SE: measure both model correctness and hallucination rates.

----
Slide 7: Fallback policy templates (examples)
- Latency-first fallback: if p95 > 800ms for 10m window -> route to lower-cost quantized variant.
- Quality-first fallback: if evaluation metric (BLEU/ROUGE/Likelihood-of-accept) drops > 8% on fixed set -> route to higher-precision variant and alert.
- Mixed policy: time-of-day routing for batch non-interactive traffic.

----
Slide 8: Measurement plan & dashboards
- Minimum metrics: token count, requests, p50/p95/p99 latency, model-switch events, top error classes.
- Suggested dashboard widgets: rolling 24h latency heatmap, fallback rate trend, sample-of-the-day quality audit.
- Weekly deliverable to customer: 1 page summary + 3 actions.

----
Slide 9: Scripted seller language & objection handling
- Objection: "We need guaranteed latency."
  - Response: "Pilot Ops-Lite gives predictable pool capacity and automated fallbacks; we include p95 targets and a cost cap so you can evaluate risk without long-term commitment."
- Objection: "What if quality drops?"
  - Response: "We run a publisher eval set nightly; fallbacks kick in automatically and we surface a remediation plan within 24h."

----
Slide 10: Contractual checklist (pilot annex highlights)
- Duration: 6 weeks default, extendable to 12 weeks by mutual consent.
- Capacity: defined vGPU-equivalent or request units, overage treatment = capped+notify.
- Data handling: logs retained X days, optional audit export.
- Exit: simple data export + option to convert to reserved capacity terms.

----
Slide 11: Operational runbook (short)
- Day 0: onboarding call, deploy routing policy, baseline run.
- Daily: automated quality checks run; SE reviews exceptions.
- Weekly: metric review + decision (stop/continue/expand).
- Escalation: SE -> Solutions Eng -> On-call runtime lead.

----
Slide 12: Template tests & example prompts
- Provide 10 canned prompts that capture latency-sensitive flows and 8 that capture hallucination risk.
- Example latency-sensitive prompt: "Summarize this message in <= 30 tokens for a push notification."
- Example hallucination test: knowledge cutoff facts + hallucination trap questions.

----
Slide 13: Seller playbook steps (one-page cheat)
- 1) Run quick qualification: expected qps, latency requirement, regulatory constraints.
- 2) Offer pilot, share one-pager, schedule D0 onboarding within 5 business days.
- 3) Instrument eval set, turn on cost cap, and start 6-week timer.

----
Slide 14: Open questions & TODOs (notes to self)
- Define default vGPU-equivalent for 'small' pilot (proposal: 1.5).
- Confirm SLO numeric thresholds with runtime team (action: ping @Evan).
- Create a 1-click console template for playwright demos (owner: Priya).
- Legal: verify data retention language with contracts.

----
Slide 15: Appendix — sample customer-facing one-pager (copy-paste)
- Short email template, one-pager summary, and bulleted pilot annex.

Notes: This slide kit is intentionally lightweight and built to be copy-pasted into slide decks or shared as a single-page pitch. It contains rough seller scripts, technical checks, and an explicit decision cadence so SEs can run a fast low-friction pilot. Several items marked TODO. Use linked artifacts for the canonical runbook and Jira tickets.
